items.title: Halliburton, TechnipFMC, Antero Resources, APA Corporation, and Transocean Stocks Trade Up, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks jumped in the morning session after Brent crude failed to break below $80 and rebounded to the mid-$80s, as traders kept a geopolitical risk premium priced into oil despite ongoing Strait of Hormuz negotiations. Over the previous 24 hours, the UAE-vessel incident reversed the earlier price drop that had assumed a path to de-escalation.
